From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 11:32:00 -0800
Subject: FW: Intro + 60m overview — Redwood inference for OrionHealth

Marissa / Vivek / Irene —

Orion just confirmed security + procurement want to join. John asked whether we want to keep the single 60m or split into two focused blocks (technical deep-dive for security/infra + procurement/contracting). Procurement noted they might only need 30 minutes but require our pricing/retention slide up front.

Given travel windows and East Coast availability, we should propose two options to them:
- Option A: One 90-minute combined session (technical + procurement) — more efficient but longer.
- Option B: Separate 45-minute technical session (security/infra) + 30-minute procurement follow-up on contracting/pricing the next day.

I’m leaning to Option B because it gives security time to run through their checklist without procurement sitting through low-level infra detail. Thoughts? Also confirm if the security questionnaire they promised is useful for us to pre-fill ahead of the session — it could speed the call.

Naomi
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 12:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FW: Intro + 60m overview — Redwood inference for OrionHealth

Agree with Option B. For security: we should ask for their SOC 2 scope and any network/topology constraints ahead of time. I can lead the infra/security portion, Marissa can cover product demo and orchestration, Irene can handle procurement Qs and next steps.

I'll block a 45-minute slot on our side Thu 10:00–10:45 PT for security/infra and 30 minutes Fri 10:00–10:30 PT for procurement, then propose those to John. If they prefer a single slot, we can offer Thu 10–11:30 PT (90m).

Vivek
VP, Platform & Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Calendar reflow request — additional security & procurement leads added

John / Procurement —

Thanks for the quick response and for looping procurement. Based on our internal sync we propose Option B (split sessions) to make the time more efficient for your teams:

- Security & Infra (45m): Thu, Nov 5 — 10:00–10:45 PT — leads: Vivek (infra/security lead), Marissa (product demos + orchestration)
- Procurement (30m): Fri, Nov 6 — 10:00–10:30 PT — leads: Irene (contracts), Naomi (AM)

If East Coast folks prefer local time, these map to Thu 13:00–13:45 ET and Fri 13:00–13:30 ET. Send any security questionnaire or SOC scope to orion-security@redwood.ai and we’ll pre-populate answers where possible.

I’ve attached the agenda and a short security checklist (we received from your team last week) — see attachments. I’ll send calendar invites once you confirm both slots work.

Quick asks:
- Can procurement confirm they only need 30 minutes?
- Can security share the questionnaire now so Vivek can pre-fill and prepare specific infra diagrams?

Best,
Naomi Feldman
